# Standalone ggml IQ-format reference code (MIT). See SOURCE.md.
foreach(_tgt ggml_iq ggml_iq_shared)
  if(_tgt STREQUAL "ggml_iq")
    add_library(${_tgt} STATIC ggml-iq.c)
  else()
    add_library(${_tgt} SHARED ggml-iq.c)
    set_target_properties(${_tgt} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME ggml_iq)
  endif()
  target_include_directories(${_tgt} PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_compile_features(${_tgt} PUBLIC c_std_11)
  target_compile_options(${_tgt} PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
  set_target_properties(${_tgt} PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
  target_link_libraries(${_tgt} PRIVATE m)
endforeach()
